names.ru: Построение Подавления Реки и Запечатывания Лотоса

summary.text: River suppression lotus sealing formation is Heavenly Court's super immortal formation on the River of Time, garrisoned by rank seven Gu Immortals and already known to Fang Yuan from being locked inside it.

claims.text: Heavenly Court builds and garrisons the river suppression lotus sealing formation on the River of Time. Gu Immortals at rank seven control formation cores inside it.
The text calls it a super immortal formation; if it collapses, those controllers face heavy backlash.
Fang Yuan already understands the formation in depth because he was locked inside it and broke out personally.
Heavenly Court used it to trap a stone lotus island found while hunting Red Lotus true inheritances.

Inside the formation, time path is restricted while other paths are amplified, so non time path Gu Immortals can fight outside Immortal Gu Houses without the formation breaking. Destroying it forces fighters such as Feng Jiu Ge and Xing Ye Wang back into their Immortal Gu Houses.
The formation can float and slowly drift along the River of Time’s surface, but that drift is too slow to escape a live battle.

Five Elements Grandmaster, using intel from Fang Yuan, modifies five elements profound light against this formation. Year End Gatehouse fires five colored light that melts layers of the formation and opens a huge hole; half the formation is destroyed and brought to the brink of collapse before rank seven controllers stabilize it with a shrinking hole still present.
Fang Yuan and Bing Sai Chuan then focus attacks on the formation. Fang Yuan shoots Luo Po seal into it, and the formation disintegrates piece by piece until about one third remains.

After Luo Po seal, the heavily damaged formation breaks in a chain of explosions. Most of its Immortal Gu are destroyed, and the Gu Immortals controlling it die one by one as river water restores the River of Time to normal.

Heavenly Court later says it has lost control over the River of Time and needs to lay down the river suppression lotus sealing formation there while building time path Immortal Gu Houses without regard for cost.

In one later battle the formation sits behind Heavenly Court with many Gu Immortals garrisoned on formation cores. Fang Yuan bombards it, kills many rank seven controllers, and destroys it completely, wasting that construction effort.

Duke Long later treats the river suppression lotus sealing formation as Heavenly Court’s greatest achievement in that search, still short of finding a Red Lotus stone island at that moment. When a confirmed Red Lotus stone island appears, Heavenly Court orders the formation set up quickly and calls for reinforcements against Fang Yuan.

While building around that stone island, Heavenly Court splits Gu Immortals into four groups. The first group handles the formation core. The second and third groups have similar strength. The fourth group is smaller and handles emergencies. Split apart, the formation has one hundred and thirty-eight sub formations.

The second group adds rank eight Immortal Gu Suppression onto three finished supplementary formations. Suppression is a rule path Immortal Gu and one of the formation’s core Immortal Gu; it must be the first rank eight Immortal Gu arranged there, after which later steps can proceed. Fang Yuan attacks while the formation is still incomplete.

Before the fate war, Fang Yuan fights Heavenly Court Gu Immortals on the River of Time. In one battle he destroys the river suppression lotus sealing formation and obtains suppression Gu from it. Suppression Gu is rank eight.
